summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests adding a single dose of high dose rate brachytherapy (a type of radiation) before robotic prostate surgery in men with newly diagnosed, high-risk, non-metastatic prostate cancer. The radiation is given as one 15 Gy dose 4 to 8 weeks before robotic-assisted laparoscopic prostatectomy (RALP), and some patients also receive androgen blockade for 12 weeks starting 8 weeks after surgery. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the trial is Phase 1/2.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1/2 evalúa agregar una sola dosis de braquiterapia de alta tasa de dosis (un tipo de radiación) antes de la cirugía robótica de próstata en hombres con cáncer de próstata de alto riesgo, recién diagnosticado y sin metástasis. La radiación se administra en una dosis única de 15 Gy entre 4 y 8 semanas antes de la prostatectomía laparoscópica asistida por robot (RALP), y algunos pacientes también reciben bloqueo androgénico durante 12 semanas, comenzando 8 semanas después de la cirugía. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Newly diagnosed prostate adenocarcinoma confirmed by biopsy, without metastatic disease.
Negative bone scan and CT scan or PSMA-PET for spread of disease.
Has a high-risk feature, such as PSA 20 or higher, Gleason score 8 or higher, or stage T3a or higher.
Age 40 or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 1.
Medically fit for surgery and brachytherapy, as judged by the principal investigator.
not_for: Metastatic disease shown on bone scan, CT, pelvic MRI, or PSMA-PET.
Declared high risk for anesthesia by a physician.
Androgen deprivation therapy within the past 6 months.
